rules: Use an explicit source/reference identifier as identity when present.
Treat human-readable names as labels, not authoritative identity.
One stable identifier may legitimately have multiple labels or historical/source names.
One label mapping to multiple identifiers is ambiguous and requires explicit mapping/review.
Fuzzy matching may generate review candidates only and never creates an authoritative mapping.

temporal.sourceRevisionOrder: Git commit time and commit ancestry
temporal.reason: Git history is bounded historical revision input; Beam watermark semantics are reserved for unbounded sources.

rules: Do not infer rename from drop+add when source format has no stable field IDs.
An explicit ISO/IEC 11179 item mapping may establish semantic correspondence across names.
Add/drop/reorder/type-change are recorded as schema transitions even when the current storage layer can physically read them.
Iceberg activation is gated on real table-level snapshot/evolution/concurrent-writer/time-travel or row-lineage requirements.
